desc: At maxcpus=1, GL9755 exposes SD64 and its ext4 loop root reaches ttydc0, OpenRC, and persistent writes. SMP panic tests later left both filesystems dirty. Ticket 215 owns repair; ticket 216 owns the fail-closed identity gates and clean PID-1 shutdown. Multi-core use remains blocked by ticket 205.
author: claude
review_blocker: Tickets 215 and 216 require independent exact review and must run in order. The fixture is currently dirty; no SD-root RW mount is allowed before 215 passes.
